requirements.text: office. Our team follows a hybrid schedule working in-office three days a week and remotely for the rest.
Master’s in a quantitative field such as Data Science, Operations Research, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or related field

We’re looking for a self-directed, analytical, and curious Data Scientist II with 2+ years of hands-on experience to join our team working on the core optimization and bidding logic of the Nexxen Demand-Side Platform (DSP). You will work on problems at the intersection of machine learning, large-scale data processing, and ad delivery performance and your work will directly impact how we bid, win, and optimize impressions across real-time programmatic advertising exchanges.
3+ years of experience in a data science or applied machine learning role, ideally in a high-scale, real-time environment.
Proficient with applied machine learning techniques (classification, regression, evaluation metrics, etc.), especially tree-based models like XGBoost.

Comfortable navigating large, complex legacy codebases and proposing changes to production systems. Bonus: comfortable using LLM-based tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.
Strong programming skills in Python, and SQL.
Experience with Scala/Apache Spark for distributed data processing and machine learning at scale.
Strong written and verbal communication skills — able to synthesize technical findings into clear, actionable insights.
Self-directed, curious, and able to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving industry.

Comfortable navigating large, complex legacy codebases and proposing changes to production systems. Bonus: comfortable using LLM-based tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.
Design, implement, evaluate and help deploy machine learning models for bidding, pacing, KPI prediction (Click, Action, Viewability etc.) and Forecasting.
